remarks: LOOKING FOR A QUICK CLOSE on a turnkey ranch? This jewel, meticulously maintained for years by the previous seller, is available again after unfortunate circumstances prevented the new owners from moving into the home. Located on a quiet street not far from the shores of Lake Erie, this three-bedroom home comes with two full bathrooms and remains in impeccable condition with updates in all the right places, great space and charm. The home feels larger than its 1,396 square feet suggests once you get inside and absorb the cathedral ceilings in the family room and natural light that pours into the home. Stunning kitchen includes quartz countertops, butler’s pantry and sliding glass door leading to a fantastic deck and private backyard. Large primary bedroom with ensuite is accompanied by two other bedrooms that also provide plenty of space. LVP flooring graces most of the first floor, proving beauty and durability. First-floor laundry is conveniently tucked away in mud room leading from the garage. Massive basement includes year-old furnace. Search and survey were completed in July, allowing sellers to accelerate closing process. Showings begin immediately. All offers must be submitted by 10 am Wednesday, Aug. 26.
